note: Machine-usable stat effects of every Forge race's four racials, read strictly from tooltip text. Values appear only where the text states the number. Tooltips (tip) from the beta client, build 1.60.1.70291.

Orc.tip: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

Orc.summary: Curse & Bane immunity, -15% magic damage taken
Orc.tip: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 15% for 8 sec.
Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1% while you have an axe or a two-handed axe equipped.
Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

Undead.tip: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. Since beta build 1.60.1.70291 the client does this with a 0.1 sec immunity instead of a dispel; the tooltip did not change.

5 yd, 2 min cooldown. When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.
Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

Undead.summary: 5% chance (casters 10%) to drain up to 5% HP
Undead.tip: Your spells and attacks have a 5% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. Priests, Mages and Warlocks get a 10% chance.

Tauren.tip: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

Tauren.summary: Grow a duplicate herb, no Herbalism needed
Tauren.tip: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.

Tauren.summary: +1% speed per 5 sec moving, up to 30%
Tauren.tip: Gain 1% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 30% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect.
Total Health increased by 5% and chance to hit increased by 1%.

Troll.tip: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.
Channeled, 3 min cooldown. Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.
Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

Troll.summary: +10% Health regen, 10% of it in combat
Troll.tip: Health regeneration rate increased by 10%. In addition, 10% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.

Skyborne (Windshaper).tip: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Attempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement and mounted movement speeds by 10%. Lasts 30 sec if no elemental convergence is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.
Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 1%.
Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

Human.tip: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Stun effects.
Instant, 3 min cooldown. Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.
Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2% while you have a sword or two-handed sword equipped.

Dwarf.tip: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.
Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts until cancelled.
Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1% while you have a mace or two-handed mace equipped.
Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

Night Elf.tip: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.
Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.
Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

Gnome.tip: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

Instant, 2 min cooldown. Your next 3 non-periodic damaging abilities have their Mana, Rage or Energy cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage. The Priest version also counts healing abilities (10% more healing); the Mage version counts periodic damage too.
Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5% (one version per power type).
Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.

Skyborne (High Order).tip: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

2 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Attempt to tap into the power of a nearby ley line, increasing your Health and Mana regeneration by 100%. Lasts 15 sec if no ley line is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.
Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 1%.
Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.
